title: Return type jet microchannel radiator and heat dissipation method
events: 2020-02-14 | Application filed by Xian Jiaotong University
abstract: Abstract Translated from Chinese 公开了折返式射流微通道散热器及散热方法，折返式射流微通道散热器中，微通道基板设有微通道；射流孔板层叠于微通道基板上且层间密封连接，射流孔板包括多个射流入口孔和多个回流出口孔；分配器层叠于射流孔板上且层间密封连接，分配器中，第一分配腔连通进液管，多个第二分配腔分别连通第一分配腔和射流入口孔，工质经由第一分配腔水平流动地导入第二分配腔中后垂直进入射流入口孔以冲击微通道的底壁面，多个第二回液腔分别连通回流出口孔和第一回液腔，冲击微通道的底壁面的工质折返进入回流出口孔，进入回流出口孔的工质经由第二回液腔进入第一回液腔，进入第一回液腔的工质经由回液管排出。 Disclosed are a fold-back jet micro-channel radiator and a heat dissipation method. In the fold-back jet micro-channel radiator, a micro-channel substrate is provided with a micro-channel; a jet orifice plate is laminated on the micro-channel substrate and is sealed and connected between layers, and the jet orifice plate comprises a plurality of a plurality of jet inlet holes and a plurality of return outlet holes; the distributor is stacked on the jet orifice plate and is tightly connected between layers. In the distributor, the first distribution chamber is connected to the liquid inlet pipe, and the plurality of second distribution chambers are respectively connected to the first distribution chamber and the jet inlet hole, the working medium is horizontally introduced into the second distribution chamber through the first distribution cavity and then vertically enters the jet inlet hole to impact the bottom wall of the microchannel. In the liquid return cavity, the working medium that hits the bottom wall of the microchannel is turned back into the return flow outlet hole, the working medium entering the return flow exit hole enters the first liquid return cavity through the second liquid return cavity, and the working medium entering the first liquid return cavity passes through the return flow cavity. Liquid pipe discharge.

第一回液腔，进入所述回流出口孔的工质经由第二回液腔进入第一回液腔， The first liquid return cavity, the working medium entering the return flow outlet hole enters the first liquid return cavity through the second liquid return cavity, 回液管，其连通第一回液腔，进入所述第一回液腔的工质经由所述回液管排出，所述第一分配腔和/或第二分配腔为沿流向楔形渐缩结构，所述第二回液腔和/或第一回液腔为楔形渐扩结构。 A liquid return pipe, which communicates with the first liquid return cavity, and the working medium entering the first liquid return cavity is discharged through the liquid return pipe, and the first distribution cavity and/or the second distribution cavity is tapered in a wedge shape along the flow direction structure, the second liquid return cavity and/or the first liquid return cavity is a wedge-shaped gradually expanding structure.

title: Smart cold plate system with active and passive features for data center cooling system
abstract: Abstract Translated from Chinese 公开了用于数据中心冷却系统的具有有源和无源特征的智能冷板系统，还公开了用于冷却数据中心的系统和方法。在至少一个实施例中，冷板具有微通道和热管，以在使用微通道的冷板的有源操作模式中支撑第一流体，并在使用热管的冷板的无源操作模式中支撑第二流体。 Disclosed are intelligent cold plate systems with active and passive features for data center cooling systems, and also disclosed are systems and methods for cooling data centers. In at least one embodiment, the cold plate has microchannels and heat pipes to support a first fluid in an active operating mode of the cold plate using the microchannels and to support a second fluid in a passive operating mode of the cold plate using the heat pipes.

A data center cooling system, comprising: 冷板，其包括微通道和热管，所述微通道在所述冷板的操作的有源模式中支撑第一流体，所述第一流体通过至少一个流量控制器的作用流过所述微通道，并且所述热管在所述冷板的操作的无源模式中支撑第二流体，所述第二流体通过所述热管的蒸发器部分和冷凝器部分之间的温度差和毛细管作用在所述热管中循环； a cold plate including microchannels and heat pipes, the microchannels supporting a first fluid in an active mode of operation of the cold plate, the first fluid flowing through the microchannels by action of at least one flow controller, and the heat pipes supporting a second fluid in a passive mode of operation of the cold plate, the second fluid circulating in the heat pipes by capillary action and a temperature difference between an evaporator portion and a condenser portion of the heat pipes; 处理器，其用于使用一个或更多个神经网络以至少部分地基于来自与计算设备或所述冷板相关联的一个或更多个传感器的传感器输入来推测一个或更多个冷却需求，以使得所述至少一个流量控制器以至少部分地基于所述一个或更多个冷却需求，来选择性地启动所述冷板的所述操作的所述有源模式和所述无源模式。 and a processor for using one or more neural networks to infer one or more cooling demands based at least in part on sensor inputs from one or more sensors associated with a computing device or the cold plate, so that the at least one flow controller selectively initiates the active mode and the passive mode of operation of the cold plate based at least in part on the one or more cooling demands.

title: Internal Recirculation Cooling Module
events: 2024-07-18 | Application filed by Jetcool Technologies Inc
abstract: Improved cooling modules and methods are configured to recirculate the liquid coolant fluid inside the cooling modules so that the same liquid cooling fluid impinges the surfaces of the heat-generating electronic components (or cooling plates in thermal communication with the heat-generating electronic components) multiple times before exiting the cooling module, thereby allowing a given flow of coolant fluid to be re-used several times over. With each re-use of the coolant fluid, the flow rate demand drops, reducing infrastructure required to achieve higher performance in direct and indirect micro-convective impingement cooling applications.
claim1: 1 . A cooling module, comprising: (a) a jet plate comprising an upper face, a lower face, a first segment that includes a first array of microjet nozzles extending through the jet plate from the upper face of the jet plate to the lower face of the jet plate, and a second segment that includes second array of microjet nozzles extending through the jet plate from the upper face of the jet plate to the lower face of the jet plate, and (b) a housing; (c) a ceiling disposed between the jet plate and the housing, the ceiling comprising a first ceiling-mounted boundary extending from the ceiling to the upper face of the jet plate and a second ceiling-mounted boundary extending from the ceiling to the upper face of the jet plate, (d) a base plate comprising a cooling surface, a first cooling surface-mounted boundary extending from the cooling surface to the lower face of the jet plate, and a second cooling surface-mounted boundary extending from the cooling surface to the lower face of the jet plate; (f) a fastening system for attaching the cooling module to a circuit board having one or more heat-generating electronic components affixed thereto so that the cooling surface of the base plate will be in thermal communication with said one or more heat-generating electronic components on the circuit board and absorbs heat generated by said one or more heat-generating electronic components while the circuit board is in operation; title: Configurable cold plate for data center cooling system
abstract: Abstract Translated from Chinese 公开了数据中心冷却系统的可配置冷板，具体公开了一种可配置且用于数据中心液体冷却系统的冷板。冷板包括第一部分、第二部分和中间层，中间层是可变的并且具有使冷却剂能够流过中间层的第一通道，并且具有第二通道或至少一个适配的第二通道，用于将冷却剂或冷却剂流集中到可配置冷板内的至少一个区域，该区域至少对应于关联计算设备的发热特征。 A configurable cold plate for a data center cooling system is disclosed, specifically a configurable cold plate for a data center liquid cooling system. The cold plate includes a first portion, a second portion, and an intermediate layer. The intermediate layer is variable and has a first channel allowing coolant to flow through it, and a second channel or at least one adapted second channel for concentrating coolant or coolant flow into at least one region within the configurable cold plate, the region at least corresponding to the heat dissipation characteristics of the associated computing device.
claim1: 1.一种用于数据中心液体冷却系统的冷板，包括： 1. A cold plate for a data center liquid cooling system, comprising: 第一部分、第二部分和中间层，其中，所述第一部分和所述第二部分气密且可移除地密封在一起，所述中间层可移除地位于所述第一部分和所述第二部分内； A first part, a second part, and an intermediate layer, wherein the first part and the second part are hermetically and removably sealed together, and the intermediate layer is removably located within the first part and the second part; 其中，所述中间层包括至少一个第一通道和第二通道，用于使得冷却剂能够从所述至少一个第一通道流过所述第二通道，再从与所述至少一个第一通道不同的第一通道流出，所述第二通道用于将所述冷却剂或冷却剂流集中到所述第二通道内，位于所述中间层中的所述第二通道至少对应于关联计算设备的发热特征，并且所述中间层能够被第二中间层替换，以解决由第二关联计算设备的第二组件产生的第二热量。 The intermediate layer includes at least one first channel and a second channel, which allow coolant to flow from the at least one first channel through the second channel and then out through a first channel different from the at least one first channel. The second channel is used to concentrate the coolant or coolant flow into the second channel. The second channel located in the intermediate layer corresponds at least to the heat dissipation characteristics of the associated computing device, and the intermediate layer can be replaced by a second intermediate layer to address the second heat generated by the second component of the second associated computing device.
